title: Cola y concurrencia (múltiples jobs)
criterio: Valida que múltiples POST /factory/jobs incrementan la lista y que health refleja queue coherente — GET /factory/jobs → 200 {jobs: eachLike min:2 con id regex, phase type, state queued|running|done|error, dir regex Windows} + GET /factory/health → 200 {queue:{pending:integer, running:integer}, uptime:integer, version like "local", ts regex ISO8601}. Cierra gap de concurrencia F02/F04 (solo 1 job).
